name: android-vitals-mcp

tools.name: get_crash_metrics
tools.description: Fetches Android vitals crash rates from Google Play: user-perceived crash rate (daily, 7-day and 28-day user-weighted — the rate Play's bad-behavior threshold applies to), plain crashRate (includes background crashes), and distinctUsers.

days.description: Number of days to fetch, ending 2 days ago (Play data lags). Default 7.

dimensions.description: Breakdown for the per-group section. Default ["versionCode"]. Use ["versionCode", "apiLevel"] to find OS-specific regressions, or [] for the overall figures only.

versionCodes.description: Only include these versionCodes (e.g. the latest two builds).

apiLevels.description: Only include these Android API levels, e.g. ["34", "35"].

format.description: summary (default): overall figures plus the top groups, rates in percent. raw: every daily row from the API as fractions (0–1) — large; use only to debug.

limit.description: summary only: maximum groups returned, ranked by average daily distinctUsers.

tools.name: get_memory_metrics
tools.description: Fetches memory usage percentiles (P50, P75, P90, P95, P99) for anonymous RSS + swap and for bitmaps, one section per metric set. Supports the extra breakdowns processName and appState.

days.description: Number of days to fetch, ending 2 days ago (Play data lags). Default 7.

dimensions.description: Breakdown for the per-group section. Default ["versionCode"]. Use ["versionCode", "apiLevel"] to find OS-specific regressions, or [] for the overall figures only. Memory also supports "processName" and "appState"; use ["appState"] to compare with Play Console, whose memory figures track foreground use.

versionCodes.description: Only include these versionCodes (e.g. the latest two builds).

apiLevels.description: Only include these Android API levels, e.g. ["34", "35"].

format.description: summary (default): overall figures plus the top groups. raw: every daily row from the API — large; use only to debug.

limit.description: summary only: maximum groups returned, ranked by average daily distinctUsers.

tools.name: get_battery_metrics
tools.description: Fetches battery vitals, one section per metric set: excessive wakeup rate (users with more than 10 AlarmManager wakeups per hour) and stuck background wake lock rate (users with a wake lock held in the background for over 1 hour); daily, 7-day and 28-day user-weighted.

days.description: Number of days to fetch, ending 2 days ago (Play data lags). Default 7.

dimensions.description: Breakdown for the per-group section. Default ["versionCode"]. Use ["versionCode", "apiLevel"] to find OS-specific regressions, or [] for the overall figures only.

versionCodes.description: Only include these versionCodes (e.g. the latest two builds).

apiLevels.description: Only include these Android API levels, e.g. ["34", "35"].

format.description: summary (default): overall figures plus the top groups, rates in percent. raw: every daily row from the API as fractions (0–1) — large; use only to debug.

limit.description: summary only: maximum groups returned, ranked by average daily distinctUsers.

tools.name: get_error_counts
tools.description: Fetches absolute error report counts and affected users per reportType (CRASH / ANR), summed over the window. Add "issueId" to dimensions to count per error issue (ids come from search_error_issues).

days.description: Number of days to fetch, ending 2 days ago (Play data lags). Default 7.

dimensions.description: Breakdown for the per-group section. Default ["versionCode"]. Use ["versionCode", "apiLevel"] to find OS-specific regressions, or [] for the overall figures only. Use ["issueId"] to count per error issue.

versionCodes.description: Only include these versionCodes (e.g. the latest two builds).

apiLevels.description: Only include these Android API levels, e.g. ["34", "35"].

format.description: summary (default): overall figures plus the top groups. raw: every daily row from the API — large; use only to debug.

limit.description: summary only: maximum groups returned, ranked by total error reports in the window.

reportType.description: Only include this report type. Omit to get CRASH and ANR.

tools.name: search_error_issues
tools.description: Lists error issues (crash / ANR clusters Google Play groups by likely root cause), ranked by affected users or report count: type, cause, location, affected users and their share, report count, first and last app version and API level, and a Play Console link.

days.description: Number of complete UTC days to search, ending at the start of today. Default 7.

userPerceivedOnly.description: Only errors users perceived (the ones Play's bad-behavior thresholds count).

orderBy.description: Rank by affected users or by report count (descending).

limit.description: Maximum issues returned (about 1 KB each; capped at 100).

includeSampleReport.description: Add one sample reportId per issue.

tools.name: get_error_reports
tools.description: Fetches individual error reports with the Android-generated stack trace / ANR dump, device, API level, app version and version-control info. Pass issueId from search_error_issues to get reports for one issue. Report text is cut to maxChars (a single ANR dump can exceed 100K characters).

issueId.description: Only reports for this error issue (from search_error_issues).

days.description: Number of complete UTC days to search, ending at the start of today. Default 7.

userPerceivedOnly.description: Only errors users perceived (the ones Play's bad-behavior thresholds count).

maxChars.description: Characters of report text kept per report.

tools.name: list_anomalies
tools.description: Lists anomalies Google Play detected in the app's vitals (metric set, metric, anomalous value, dimensions, and period) that were active within the last `days` days.

days.description: Only anomalies active within this many days. Default 90.

tools.name: get_data_freshness
tools.description: Shows the latest date (and hour, where available) each vitals metric set has data for, per aggregation period. Metric sets the app can't access are reported as unavailable.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: Lists the releases currently serving on each Play track with their versionCodes — use it to map versionCodes in other tools' output to release names.
